scope.discovery: Every header, import, package, token, and build hit is only a candidate anchor. Discovery never classifies a repository.
scope.confirmed: Only an uncommented exact SDK include in host-owned C/C++/CUDA source, or an executable non-shadowed import in host-owned Python/notebook code, is sufficient. Warp and Morpheus additionally require a product-specific API anchor.
scope.bundled: Evaluated only for reviewed Python distribution declarations in supported authored dependency manifests; otherwise not_evaluated.
scope.targeted: Evaluated only for reviewed official CMake/link targets in authored CMake configuration; otherwise not_evaluated.
scope.operators: not_evaluated for REQ-14 direct candidates; mature DALI and mature component extractors are unchanged
global_exclusions: private, forked, archived, or unresolved-visibility repository
vendor, third_party, generated, environment, documentation, or agent-skill path
comment, string, notebook markdown/output, malformed notebook, or non-source occurrence
project-owned local header definition or Python module/package shadow

python_import: comment, docstring, markdown, notebook output, or prose occurrence
near-name import and project-local module/package shadow
python_import_api: bare product import without a reviewed product API anchor
dual_surface: one valid surface is sufficient; evidence remains attached to that surface

bundled.method: An exact PEP 503-normalized official distribution name must occur as a structurally parsed dependency in an authored requirements file, pyproject.toml, setup.py, setup.cfg, environment YAML, Pipfile, or Docker pip-install command. Confirmed direct use takes precedence.
hard_negatives: setup extra/group key rather than dependency value
Docker option value rather than install operand
vendor, generated, environment-dump, agent-skill, or embedded-project path
malformed evidence-bearing manifest fails the repository instead of publishing a clean negative
bundled.component_operator_handling: A declaration proves only the library-level band. It never infers operators, components, frameworks, or transitive attribution.

targeted.method: An exact reviewed official imported target or canonical product linker library must occur in an authored CMake link/find command, TARGET condition, or link-library variable assignment. Confirmed and declared/bundled evidence take precedence.
targeted.discovery_note: Short family roots nominate candidates; classification rechecks the full exact allowlist below in CMake syntax.
hard_negatives: wrong-case, near-name, or unsupported CUDAToolkit:: pseudo-target
vendor, generated, environment-dump, or embedded-project path
bare product token outside reviewed CMake commands
targeted.component_operator_handling: A link target proves only the named library-level band. NPP component targets remain evidence for NPP but do not publish operators; cuBLASLt remains its own rollup child.

collision_notes: A project-owned cublasLt.h wrapper is insufficient unless that wrapper itself includes the external SDK header.
An authored build wrapper is host source; a generated build output remains excluded.

qualifying_signals: own-source exact include, case-insensitive basename: cublasmp.h or cublasMp.h
collision_notes: ROCm/TransformerEngine and copied TransformerEngine benchmark trees are upstream derivatives, not independent host adoption.
Copied CUDALibrarySamples trees are sample redistribution, not adoption.
Copied cufftXt.h definitions are local SDK copies and do not qualify.
HITS-MCM/gromacs-ramd is a reviewed copied repository and remains excluded.
Documentation and FindCuSolverMP.cmake alone are discovery anchors, never confirmed evidence.
Bundled/package evidence remains framework-transitive or generated; broad cusparseLt build-name discovery was operationally unbounded and is not sufficient for targeted classification.
A project-local wrapper occurrence alone is insufficient unless the wrapper includes the external SDK header.

The certified aarnphm/aarnphm.github.io broad blob is excluded as a discovery anchor because every match is CUtensorMap, the unrelated CUDA Driver TMA descriptor API. The exclusion is blob/path scoped, so any future independent cuTENSOR observation still nominates the repository.
4shen/webshell is excluded for cuDSS only: all 48 certified broad matches are repeated PHP malware-corpus samples under dataset/, not authored cuDSS integration evidence.
FindAMGX.cmake and other build-only mentions remain discovery anchors.

qualifying_signals: executable non-shadowed import: warp, plus a reviewed Warp API anchor (for example wp.kernel, wp.func, wp.launch, wp.tid, wp.array, wp.vec3, wp.sim)
collision_notes: A bare import of the unrelated PyPI warp namespace cannot qualify without a Warp API anchor.
physicsnemo_curator is a different package and is not a PhysicsNeMo anchor by prefix alone.
Commented lazy-import examples and QEC prose do not qualify.
Install docs and copied cuDNN headers remain non-qualifying.
Copied NvInfer definition trees are local SDK copies.
TensorRT-LLM installation prose is discovery-only.

qualifying_signals: own-source include under prefix: cutlass/ with a real header suffix
collision_notes: CUTLASS source/sample trees and copied implementations are excluded; host source outside such a root remains eligible.
Install scripts without an executable import are discovery-only.

qualifying_signals: own-source include under prefix: thrust/ with a real header suffix
collision_notes: Attribution prose and copied Thrust/rocThrust trees do not qualify.

qualifying_signals: own-source include under prefix: cub/ with a real header suffix
collision_notes: Bare CUB prose and copied CCCL/CUB trees do not qualify.
RAPIDS first-party source is excluded from external adoption.
Install checks and release-note mentions are discovery-only.
CVXPY's project-local cuopt module is a shadow and cannot prove the external package.
AI skill/reference files containing example imports are documentation and excluded.
physicsnemo_curator is a distinct package.

qualifying_signals: executable non-shadowed import: morpheus, plus an import/reference under morpheus.config, morpheus.messages, morpheus.pipeline, or morpheus.stages
collision_notes: The generic Morpheus name collides with unrelated packages/products; a product API anchor is mandatory.

qualifying_signals: own-source include under prefix: nvcomp/ with a real header suffix
collision_notes: inikep/lzbench contains a copied nvCOMP distribution under misc/ and is a hard negative.
Copied GDS samples/headers and first-party DALI shims do not qualify as external adoption.
CVCUDA/CV-CUDA is the product source, not an external adopter.
Optimization skill/reference prose is excluded.
Copied NPP header definitions are local SDK copies.
OBS/FFmpeg-style redistributed nvEncodeAPI.h definitions do not qualify by themselves; host code including the external header does.
Patch files and copied Optical Flow interface header definitions do not qualify.
The legacy nvofapi.h signal is retained for historical SDK consumers; current interface-specific headers are now explicit.
NCCL source distributions, locally modified forks, and fake SDK fixtures are not independent adoption.
ROCm/RIXL installs and includes its own nixl.h compatibility header; local-header resolution rejects it.
